concept.title: The Love We Grow Into
concept.human_truth: Mature love does not mean becoming less irritating or less human. It means learning the need beneath each other's small reactions, staying near without crowding, and still choosing the date when the plan falls apart.
concept.emotional_arc: aspirational promise -> familiar small irritation -> requested space -> respectful nearness -> noticing the deeper need -> improvised roadside date -> funny shared-habit coda
concept.format_shell: A continuous roadside date story with a cover flash-forward and one explicit two-vignette storybook coda.
concept.public_send_reason: Send this to the person you want to grow into this kind of love with.
